title: Vapi vs Retell: The Price Is Close. The Contracts Are Not.
meta_description: Vapi vs Retell, read on 7 October 2026: a BAA costs $2,000 a month on Vapi and nothing to sign on Retell. Uptime, calling rules and data defaults differ too.

image.takeaway: Vapi charges $2,000 a month for its BAA; Retell charges no fee to sign one.
image.alt: Vapi vs Retell: Vapi charges $2,000 a month for a BAA and puts its first uptime SLA on a $999 package, while Retell includes a BAA and a 99.5% uptime clause on pay as you go
